nodes.name: Get current lead
nodes.notes: continueOnFail so a bad/missing leadId (404) doesn't crash the run -- the Decide node treats a missing doc as a brand-new lead (stage 'lead', no milestone) rather than failing the whole request.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, applied: true, leadId: $json.leadId, event: $json.event, fromStage: $json.fromStage, fromMilestone: $json.fromMilestone, toStage: $json.toStage, toMilestone: $json.toMilestone }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, applied: false, leadId: $json.leadId, event: $json.event, reason: $json.reason }) }}
